content:
Noah maintains the small, privacy-minded pipeline behind the Atlas. He prefers
simple exports, reversible transformations, and the local-first approach
described in [Local-first knowledge](/note/wiki/local_first_knowledge).

occurrences.context: Jamie and Noah pair on the data model, and regularly compare notes with Elena about public-space research.
Participants: Alex, Jamie, Maya, and Noah.
Maya Singh turned the research into a visual language, while Noah Williams built a lightweight data pipeline.
